In particular, a station 'Total Flow' of zero cannot automatically be called 'dry waterfall,' nor can positive flow be labeled water visibly plunging over an accessible falls.

entries.accessAssessment: Alger Falls is a real roadside cascade at the M-28/M-94 junction. The City of Munising adopted 2024–2028 Recreation Plan explicitly identifies no safe parking options; Alger County's plan independently repeats that warning. Older tourism and field reviews call it a pull-off attraction, while MDOT's general shoulder-parking FAQ is not an official safe visitor turnout or specific pedestrian-view approval. No safe lawful parking-to-view route has been demonstrated as of the November 3 review.
